game.name: Zumba Fitness Core (Europe)(En,Es)
game.desc: Like its predecessors, Zumba Fitness Core allows us to sweat blood and water on Xbox 360 through various workout sessions to music. 40 songs and several 20, 40 or 60 minute programmes are available and a daily follow-up is offered to the player in the form of statistics.
game.genre: Music and Dancing, Various, Sports / Fitness, Sports
